# Adding the Logs Bucket (base → overlays → Flux)

Note: `s3.aws.upbound.io` is the Crossplane Upbound provider group (ACK uses `s3.services.k8s.aws`). I follow the spec's authoritative group as instructed.

## 1. Base — `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    tags:
      Environment: placeholder
      ManagedBy: knr-ops
      App: myapp
      Purpose: logs
```

## 2. Base — `infra/s3/logs/bucket-versioning.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketVersioning
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        crossplane.io/claim-name: myapp-logs   # adjust to repo selector convention
    versioningConfiguration:
      - status: Enabled
```

## 3. Base — `infra/s3/logs/bucket-server-side-encryption-configuration.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        crossplane.io/claim-name: myapp-logs
    rule:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          - sseAlgorithm: AES256
```

## 4. Base — `infra/s3/logs/bucket-public-access-block.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketSelector:
      matchLabels:
        crossplane.io/claim-name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

## 5. Base — `infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - bucket-versioning.yaml
  - bucket-server-side-encryption-configuration.yaml
  - bucket-public-access-block.yaml
```

## 6. IRSA Role — `infra/iam/logs-role.yaml`

IRSA trust for the `myapp-logs` service account (OIDC provider patched per env in overlays):

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": { "Federated": "${OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN}" },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "${OIDC_PROVIDER_HOST}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs"
            }
          }
        }]
      }
    tags:
      App: myapp
      Purpose: logs-irsa
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject",
              "s3:AbortMultipartUpload",
              "s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"
            ],
            "Resource": [
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}",
              "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-${ENV}/*"
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-rw
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyArnSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app: myapp
        purpose: logs
    roleSelector:
      matchLabels:
        crossplane.io/claim-name: myapp-logs-irsa
```

Add matching labels in the base `metadata.labels` (e.g. `app: myapp`, `purpose: logs`) so selectors resolve.

## 7. Overlay — `overlays/dev/s3-logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../../infra/s3/logs
namespace: myapp-dev
patches:
  - target:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /metadata/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/forProvider/tags/Environment
        value: dev
replacements:
  - source:
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs-dev
      fieldPath: metadata.name
    targets:
      - select:
          kind: Policy
          name: myapp-logs-rw
        fieldPaths:
          - spec.forProvider.policy
        options:
          format: string  # apply via env-substitution patch below if needed
```

(Simpler alternative: use vars/`envsubst`-style patches — the key point is the bucket name suffix and the policy resource ARNs are per-env.)

`overlays/dev/s3-logs/irsa-patch.yaml` (set OIDC provider for dev cluster):

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [{
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID"},
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {"StringEquals": {
            "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVCLUSTERID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs"
          }}
        }]
      }
```

## 8. Overlay — `overlays/prod/s3-logs/kustomization.yaml`

Same as dev but:
- `name: myapp-logs-prod`, `Environment: prod`
- OIDC patch points at the **prod** cluster's provider ARN/host
- Prod region patch (`region: us-west-2` if prod lives there)

## 9. Flux — `flux/kustomizations-logs.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev/s3-logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops          # must match the existing GitRepository in flux-system
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod/s3-logs
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  timeout: 2m
  wait: true
```

## 10. SOPS note

Nothing in this change requires a secret — bucket config and IAM policy are non-sensitive. If the OIDC provider thumbprint or an access key ever needs storing, add it as a SOPS-encrypted `Secret` in the overlay (`.sops.yaml` already governs `infra/**` path rules), e.g. `overlays/dev/s3-logs/oidc-secret.enc.yaml` created with `sops --encrypt --in-place`.

## Verification

```bash
kustomize build overlays/dev/s3-logs  | kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f -
kustomize build overlays/prod/s3-logs | kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f -
flux reconcile kustomization s3-logs-dev --with-source
```

Acceptance mapping: versioning ✅ (BucketVersioning), AES256 ✅ (SSE config), no public access ✅ (PublicAccessBlock all-true), least-privilege IRSA ✅ (explicit actions, no wildcards), env isolation ✅ (separate overlays + separate Flux kustomizations).
